subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`, leaving prompt-driven selective reply routing to a separate policy/API item?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but allowing prompts or rules to choose delivery channels would change deterministic routing behavior and plugin/message delivery policy.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, channel actions, reaction guidance, and message hints only in the command prompt bundle.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track prompt-driven channel-selective replies separately with an explicit API and policy design before changing delivery behavior.

options.title: Decline Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Keep channel routing host-controlled and close the broader selective-routing request after the metadata gap is fixed or documented.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, channel actions, reaction guidance, and message hints only in the command prompt bundle.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest history on the shared command prompt bundle and already posted the strongest scope guidance on this issue.
